title: Designing Trust in Responsible AI at SKKU
summary: Park's July talk considered how AI for aging can support emotional connection while preserving autonomy.

sources.label: Read Chorong Park's original LinkedIn post

paragraphs.text: At Sungkyunkwan University, Chorong Park presented a July 20 talk on responsible AI, aging, autonomy, and emotional connection. She shared photographs and reflections from the visit in an August 20, 2026, post.

The talk asked designers to consider trust alongside intelligence. Park described questions about how verbal and nonverbal cues shape people's experience of AI, particularly when systems take on socially engaging or companion-like roles.

Her account thanked Hayeon Song and the Human-AI Interaction Lab in the Department of Interaction Science for hosting the exchange. The discussion brought human-robot interaction into conversation with broader work on responsible AI.

Park also expressed interest in future research connecting colleagues in South Korea and the United States. That interest was framed around trust, privacy, and autonomy, with emotional connection treated as a design responsibility rather than proof of a system's safety.
